displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 288BNV Evolution heat pump or 189BNV air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 46 is 4 short and 6 long
meaning: Brownout. Line voltage at the outdoor unit is low. Reset time is 6 minutes.
causes: Bad connection on L1 and L2
diySteps: Count 4 short flashes and 6 long flashes. The 6-minute reset is the control waiting, not a repair

Technician: check for line voltage approximately greater than 180 V. If it is less than 180 V and that persists, contact the power provider. Then check the line-side and load-side connections. If those are good, replace the inverter
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician or the electric utility. Do not use a non-contact tester as a substitute for the 180 V check. That reading is a technician meter step.
sourceTitle: Bryant 288BNV heat pump / 189BNV air conditioner service manual (SM288BNV-189BNV-04)
